verdict.rationale: Codegen is a hosted agent platform, so plan-based task and concurrency limits are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions plans, daily task quotas, concurrency caps, or a usage/limits dashboard. The documented controls (listing, pausing, resuming and stopping agent runs, and agent permissions) are adjacent run-management features, not plan limits.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows
